candidates.description: This vector represents common Hindi verb roots and inflectional suffixes.
This feature vector represents Devanagari script characters and common sub-word letter combinations used in Hindi typography.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign suffixes and syllable combinations, particularly involving the 'aa' and 'i' vowel sounds.
These tokens represent common Hindi words, grammatical particles, and morphemes extracted from a text corpus.
These tokens represent common Hindi root words, prefixes, and grammatical suffixes.
This feature vector activates on sub-word and character sequences characteristic of Hindi and other Devanagari-script text.
This feature vector represents common suffixes, prefixes, and common words in the Hindi language.
This vector represents Devanagari consonant conjuncts and character combinations containing halant markers.
These tokens are Hindi nasalizing vowel signs and anusvara diacritics used in Devanagari script.
This vector activates on common Sanskrit and Hindi lexical prefixes, morphemes, and sub-word units starting with the consonant 'स' (sa).
